newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-HEALY HAILS SRI LANKA VICTORY IN WORLD SERIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-HEALY HAILS SRI LANKA VICTORY IN WORLD SERIES.

text.p: Australian captain Ian Healy praised Sri Lanka's decisive 50-run victory in Saturday's Singer World Series final.
"Sri Lanka put us under more pressure than we could absorb," Healy said. "I give full credit to them. They are a fantastic team in their own conditions here."
Sri Lankan captain Arjuna Ranatunga said: "Our victory proves we're still world champions in one-day cricket."
Asked about hostile crowd reaction when he came out to bat, Healy said: "I got over it and in the end I had some fun with the crowd."

Relations between the sides were badly strained last year when the Sri Lankans were first found guilty and then cleared of ball tampering, and spinner Muttiah Muralitharan was called for throwing during a controversial test series in Australia.
The Australians were making their first visit to the Indian Ocean island since boycotting a World Cup fixture there in February because of fears over ethnic violence.
